intro.description: Why information changes the game, and what you will be able to do by the end of this module.

lesson1.description: Lesson 6.1: information is not the same as truth, and people act on the game as they perceive it.

lesson2.description: Lesson 6.2: information asymmetry, the problem with just asking, and private types.

lesson3.description: Lesson 6.3: signals, costly signals and cheap talk.

lesson4.description: Lesson 6.4: beliefs about beliefs, self-fulfilling patterns and common knowledge.

lesson5.description: Lesson 6.5: treating your interpretations as hypotheses, not facts.

practice.description: Key terms, research, the Information Map, practice, common mistakes, this week's assignment and the question to carry.
